offer: Jake Morrison follows up on his $2,500 retraining grant application submitted last tick. He sends a brief, professional inquiry to Maria Santos asking for status and expected decision timeline. He is not demanding — he is persistent. He wants to know if the grant is approved, denied, or pending, so he can plan accordingly.
why_they_accept: Maria Santos is a council member who championed the retraining grant program as a policy response to RoboRide disruption. A constituent following up in good faith is exactly what the program is designed for — it validates her initiative and requires minimal effort to respond to. Accepting (or at minimum acknowledging) the follow-up costs her nothing and is consistent with her role. She may not have finalized decisions yet, but acknowledging receipt is low friction.
